newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWEDEN SEES SEPT BORROWING NEED AT 1.4 BLN SKR.
newsitem.headline: SWEDEN SEES SEPT BORROWING NEED AT 1.4 BLN SKR.

text.p: Sweden's National Debt Office said on Monday it expected the borrowing requirement for September to amount to 1.4 billion crowns ($176.8 million).
It also revised its August figure, seeing a repayment of 7.9 billion crowns compared to a repayment of 5.1 billion crowns in its July forecast.
For July, the office said the actual borrowing requirement was 9.16 billion crowns, compared with a forecast of 7.8 billion crowns.

It left its forecasts for 1997 and 1998 unchanged. It said earlier it expected a state borrowing need of zero to 10 billion crowns this year and between breakeven to a repayment of 10 billion crowns in 1998.
